title: IRDAI clears Allianz Jio Reinsurance & Kiwi General Insurance
summary: Allianz Jio: 50:50 JV (Allianz Group Germany + Jio Financial Services)

items: Allianz Jio: 50:50 JV (Allianz Group Germany + Jio Financial Services)

Kiwi General: WestBridge Capital + Neelesh Garg (ex-MD/CEO Tata AIG). Context: **Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha (Amendment of Insurance Laws) Act, 2025** — notified 21 Dec 2025, in force from **5 Feb 2026** (🔄 same Act underlying the Feb 100%-FDI-insurance reform, Section 3). Domestic reinsurers: GIC Re + Valueattics Re

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → SBSR Act in force from 5 Feb 2026; don't confuse with its notification date (21 Dec 2025).
